agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Thanks for your time this evening. I've got some questions about the independent review of the SWIOID. I'm interested in if Snowy Hydro agrees with the findings of the draft SWIOID review.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I might pass to Dr Schweizer for any details, but we participated as fully as we could with the independent panel. We have some inaccuracies and some different interpretations, but fundamentally we think that the report as presented, with the appropriate implementation, can be achieved.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I'd only add that, as Mr Barnes has said, we worked closely and fed information into the review. We have confidence that we can work together with the department on an implementation pathway that's practical and reflects the operating realities of the scheme. That's our focus.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I am interested to drill into that a little bit. Has Snowy Hydro sought to have any of the draft reviews, findings, conclusions or recommendations changed?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Not as such. We have continued to provide analysis about different scenarios contemplated by the review, particularly related to the release of volumes of water from Tantangara into the upper Murrumbidgee. We have continued to undertake analysis as to the implications of those releases, and given our focus, really, the implications for energy reliability, our ability to support contracts in the national electricity market and, under those different scenarios, what the potential impacts might be. There are also potential impacts to Snowy 2.0 when it's completed, related to holding water in Tantangara Dam to facilitate those environmental releases. So I suppose we haven't opined on or attempted to influence the findings other than to make available the facts and the analysis about what implications those measures might have on our ability to support the energy system.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Okay. Thank you. Given that you don't disagree with the recommendations, I can take it that you are happy with the recommendations and that you think they can be implemented?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: There's a wide range of recommendations, as I know you know. There are risks associated with some of them, and we have highlighted those risks through the process.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: What are those risks, sorry?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: A lot of them come down to—well, for example, the first recommendation relates to releasing more water to support environmental outcomes.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: So if the river doesn't die, the report is very clear it is in terminal decline.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: The releases are targeted at environmental outcomes. For example, they could reflect the inflows that are available in a given year. Was it a wet year, in which case more water could be available for releases, versus a dry year. So there is quite a bit of work, I suppose, still to be done to figure out exactly how those recommendations will ultimately be implemented.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Thank you. That's useful. But, risks aside, you're confident that they can be implemented?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: It's certainly possible to target those releases. I probably don't have the expertise to comment on all of the different recommendations from the panel, but the increased volumes, again, as of the draft report, are physically possible. There was also a recommendation in the draft report, again, presuming that the final report follows the same vein, to explore physically expanding the capacity to release water from Tantangara Dam, and that, I believe, will be subject to a feasibility study to see what that would actually take to make possible.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Okay. Just to confirm, you haven't sought to change any of the other recommendations?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: We have only sought to feed in information and ensure that decision-makers had a fulsome understanding of the potential impacts of the recommendations.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: But as part of that feeding in more information, you haven't sought to change recommendations?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: No. We respect the independence of the panel.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Okay. The draft review describes the upper Murrumbidgee as being in abysmal condition, with the river receiving only a small fraction of its natural flows. Does Snowy Hydro accept that finding?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I'm afraid it's not in my area of expertise to comment on the health of the river. That's probably better left to others.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Do you have a sense of the timeline for the final—that's probably for the minister. Minister, when will the final report be released?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I'm not sure if a decision has been made about that, but obviously later tonight we will have officials from the water section of the department who are managing this process overall, and there may be more information we can relay at that point.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I assume it will be a decision for the government?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Yes, and I'm not aware of any decision being made yet about releasing that report.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Okay. I've got some questions about fish screens at Tantangara. What's Snowy Hydro's current estimate of the cost of constructing the Tantangara fish screens?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I think we have a current view of around $80 million to $100 million.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: And does your modelling suggest that the screens would reduce the risk of redfin perch coming into and establishing themselves in the upper Murrumbidgee?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Our analysis says that the risk is reduced, but it's not an impossible event. We are engaged with the department of planning at the moment on an alternative program that could have greater benefits to the fish population, and we are continuing with the construction of the screens. But because the risk is not eliminated, we are engaged with DPIRD and—excuse me on the name of the department—and Fisheries on what are a more effective program could be.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Could you give us some details of what an alternative program could be?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I can do that on notice because it has been well traversed with the departments, but it's quite a wide range of programs to support native fish populations.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: And if you went with the fish screens at Tantangara, would that construction prevent future upgrades of the Tantangara outlet to aid better water supply to the Murrumbidgee?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I will say no, but I will confirm on notice. I think the feasibility study recommended by the independent review panel would also traverse that question.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: What are the other risks to biodiversity and the ecology of the upper Murrumbidgee from Snowy Hydro 2.0?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: The upper Murrumbidgee flows in 2.0 shouldn't necessarily be changed on the operation of 2.0. It's a closed loop between Talbingo and Tantangara, so it shouldn't affect the upper Murrumbidgee. That would be in line with our current water licence and operating rules. Perhaps a briefer way to say it is the operation of Snowy 2.0 does not change our water licence obligations.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: And then, just tying off the SWIOID review, the modelling I've seen suggests that getting to the 30 per cent flows would be a fairly insignificant reduction in Snowy's capacity to generate electricity. Do you have a different view on that?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I think the short answer is: it depends. Although we generate electricity, our primary role in the electricity market is reliability. So Dr Schweizer referred to the implementation pathways, and if we were required to store water specifically for those flows at times when the electricity market is in stress, then it would have a significant impact on electricity reliability and Snowy's earnings. But we believe that an implementation pathway is to deliver the flows which minimise that. In fact, there's some scenarios where there would be no compensation required for the loss of earnings in Snowy Hydro.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Okay. And how will those details be worked out?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Well, I think our belief is that, when the final report is issued, that is a process of implementation detail that has to follow. The panel so far have understood this and been engaged on understanding the devil in the detail on implementation here.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: One of the things that we have traversed in the past is just how inflexible the timing of releases from Snowy has been, and despite an update to the setting of expectations, that doesn't seem to have changed. The review's earlier issues consultation report concluded the deed had delivered inadequate environmental water allocations and poor, inflexible timing of releases. Do you accept that, and do you think that, under an updated arrangement, that could actually be changed?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I mean, we work closely with New South Wales Water to provide flows as flexibly as the water licence allows us. But the reality is that we are subject to these rules, and we follow the rules. I think some of the implementation pathways under the independent review panel recommendation would include more flexibility. One of our recommendations would be more flexibility.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: And so you are confident that the increased flows in recommendation 1, the 30 per cent flows, can be achieved?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Fundamentally, they can be achieved. It's at what consequence for electricity, reliability and Snowy's earnings. And we think there's an implementation pathway which minimises that, maybe even to zero, so they can be achieved at no energy market cost.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: And what about the cost to the river's ecology? Will those two things align, or—

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: That's why we think there's a lot of work on the implementation pathways.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Minister, just on the timing of this, I think the drought contingency for the upper Murrumbidgee ends this financial year. Is your government looking to have the implementation of the updated agreement in place once that money is gone?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I'm sorry; I probably need to rely on some of my officials in the water section of this department to be able to answer some of these questions. And again, they will be here later this evening to be able to do that.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Sure. Thanks, Chair.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Senator Henderson.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Mr Barnes, the revised target cost to complete is $22.2 billion with the contingency buffer, which ends up at $25 billion. Can I ask: what is the revised actual total cost of the project from start to finish? Is there any difference between the two numbers?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: No. That would be the range.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Okay. So it is $25 billion?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: The range is $22.2 billion to $25 billion.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Yes, including the contingency. So that is the total cost to complete?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Yes.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: What about the cost of transmission?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Snowy Hydro isn't responsible for transmission.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: No, but are you aware of what those costs are?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I wouldn't hazard a guess of what the build-out of the grid is costing. We don't have a responsibility for that.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Like all major projects, Snowy uses the term 'earned value' to describe work that is completed against a set plan. That is planned work compared to actual work completed. I just want to draw your attention to page 26 of the ANAO report, which noted that the Snowy board tracks earned value. What is the current earned value, and is it an increase or decrease from the previous reporting period?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Earned value obviously has a financial component. The earned value has increased since the last report. But the earned value at the $22.2 billion figure is, I think, currently 54 per cent.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: How much is that increased by?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: It's actually comparing two different things. When the project cost was $12 billion, we were more progressed. Now the project cost is $22 billion. On a dollars basis, we are clearly less progressed.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: It's 54 per cent.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Yes. I would say that earned value isn't the only measure one can look at when looking at the progress of a project. You have to look at the milestones that are achieving the completion targets to deliver the infrastructure. We discussed earlier that in the excavation phase we are nearly complete. Some elements of the project are 95 per cent complete. The concreting in the powerhouse is only three per cent complete. Earned value is a complex measure, but it includes the target cost to complete. It will have gone down period on period because the target cost to complete has increased.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: And, Mr Barnes, are you embarrassed by the cost blowout of this project?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I'm incredibly disappointed here with this cost blowout. It was in place during the 2023 reset. The immaturity of the design at that stage, we didn't fully identify. We got it wrong.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I just want to do back to the current earned value. To confirm, how much of the work was planned over the last 12 months? Can you just take me through how much was planned over the last 12 months and how much of that work has actually been completed?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: At the prior target cost to complete, the planned progress over the year was 11 per cent. All of that has been completed; it's just at a higher cost.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Right. Are you confident that this project can be completed? Firstly, can it be completed given the massive logistical issues that you face and, secondly, are you confident that it can be completed for the revised cost of $25 billion?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I am confident that it can be completed. I do believe that the contingency and risk buffer we've applied to the balance—and it's $3 billion on $10 billion, not $3 billion on $22 billion—is an appropriate buffer and that it can be completed for that. The complexity of this project means that there are no cast-iron guarantees though, of course.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: When you say there are no cast-iron guarantees, where are the biggest doubts with this project?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: The two ahead of us—that mean we do most work about them; the current contract model allows us to have full visibility on risk management—are the geological zone on the headrace tunnel, for which we've bought a new tunnel-boring machine, and we have confidence that that new tunnel-boring machine will traverse that geological fault zone, and we are moving into a phase of complexity where, if you can picture a cavern the size of the Sydney Opera House inside of which we are constructing a concrete building to then build a power station inside that, using one access tunnel to get in and out, there is a degree of complexity in that process. They're the two areas right now that are exercising our minds, and they're what we're managing risks around.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Isn't it the case that the geotechnical challenges are so complex that there is still significant risk in relation to completion of this project?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I'd probably refer to two things. Three years ago, I would've been sat here when the power station complex was hardly started, and we would've said that, once the cavern is excavated by about a third, we would have gotten over a major geological risk. The cavern is now 90 per cent excavated, so that geological risk we were concerned about didn't eventuate. Two years ago, we got seriously concerned about this Long Plain fault zone, and that drove us to acquire a fourth tunnel-boring machine and put in place specific technology to cover that zone. So, yes, you're digging 40 kilometres of tunnels in a mountain and building two caverns the size of the Sydney Opera House. Geological risk is a feature of this project.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Following the so-called project reset in 2023, Snowy released its corporate plan for the financial years 2024 to 2028. At page 29 of that plan, it was stated that inflation had added to construction and labour costs. Arising from the reset, can you quantify by how much inflation has added to costs?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Is that from the reset forwards or the difference between $12 billion and $22 billion?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I'm referring to your corporate plan for the financial years 2024 to 2028, where you said, at page 29, that inflation had added to construction and labour costs. I'm trying to ask you: arising from the reset, can you quantify how much inflation has added to costs?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: At the 2024 corporate plan, we would have been referring to the escalation from $6 billion to $12 billion. I don't have that figure to hand, but I think we published that at the time. On the escalation from $12 billion to $22.2 billion, in the order of $2.5 billion is associated with escalations we didn't predict at the time of the reset.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I'm asking you about the inflationary escalation. Are we talking $100 million, $500 million? What's—

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Since the $12 billion figure, included in the $22 billion figure is $2½ billion of inflationary increases, which is why we identify that risk in our annual reports and corporate plans.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: That's an extraordinary amount just in inflation.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Any construction activity—

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: It's $2½ billion.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Sure. But my point is that any construction activity in Australia or any other country around the world has experienced cost inflation in recent years. I experienced cost inflation when I renovated my home. This is obviously a bigger example of that, but that is a fact of life with construction right around the world.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Minister, I'm not interested in you renovating your home; I'm interested in the fact that, of this project—

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I'm sorry, I'm trying to give you an analogy.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: $2½ billion is attributable to inflation costs alone.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: And any large project built anywhere around the world in recent years has experienced a high degree of cost inflation, due partly to supply chain pressures.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Are you able to give us any other information in relation to those inflationary pressures, Mr Barnes?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: They cover all sorts of things—the cost of transport, cost of diesel, cost of the steel that we have procured for the project, labour costs. It's a wide range of various aspects.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Could you just please explain how much the Commonwealth has invested in Snowy 2.0. That's a breakdown of equity, loans and the like.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Not all of this is drawn yet, but there's $4 billion of permanent equity, not to be repaid; $1.4 billion of temporary equity, to be repaid; and $4.5 billion of shareholder loan, to be repaid. We pay interest on the temporary equity and the shareholder loan at commercial rates.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I am concerned that you are going to be seeking further government support. You mentioned that before. S&P Global issued a statement upon the release of the reassessment, titled Bulletin: higher Snowy 2.0 costs necessitate further government support. Do you share the view that additional government investment will be required to complete this project?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: The advice we gave to ministers was on both the cost reassessment and the fact that we would need support to complete the project.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: And how much support do you need?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: That's subject to the department's consideration.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: No, I'm asking about the advice that you gave government. What was that advice, and how much did you advise the government that Snowy would need to complete the project?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: We didn't ask for a specific level of support or the nature of that support. It's now with the departments to consider what form that support should come in.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Mr Barnes, I'm going to ask you again. In your assessment, how much contribution from government is required to complete this project?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: The balance of $10 billion that we have got in the target cost to complete. I believe we'll have a mix of private debt that we will source from banks and the like. It will partly be contributed to from our earnings, and there will be a requirement for government support. The mix of those, I don't have.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: So we're talking, what, three-three-four? Roughly, what mix are you seeking?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: On the $12 billion target cost to complete, the mix was $4 billion of permanent support and $5.9 billion of temporary support. It's now with the departments to consider what support—

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Okay. So, of the additional $10 billion, can I assume, then, based on what you've just told me, that you would be seeking close to half of that in government support?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: We don't necessarily put a figure on it. We target a credit rating that supports our operations in the electricity market that is investment grade, and the matter nature of the support has some determination on what that credit rating will be. So I haven't got the split. We didn't recommend a split. Effectively, the request of government now is to consider what that support will look like.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Okay. So you said that you'd need another $10 billion.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: It will cost another $10 billion.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: It will cost another $10 billion. You've made it clear that you are going to need government support.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Yes.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Did you state a minimum amount of money that you would need?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: No. We said we will now work with departments to determine the right capital structure to maintain our credit rating.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Did you make a request to government for funding?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: We made a request to work with the government to determine the nature of support to maintain our credit rating.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Based on what has happened with this horrendous cost blowout, do you believe that your credit rating is potentially at risk?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: If the government don't support the company, then the credit rating is at risk, and that's the objective of the review.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Okay. Therefore, you will need a minimum contribution from government to protect your credit rating. What will that minimum contribution need to be to maintain your credit rating?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: That's the work that will now be undertaken with departments.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: So you've got no idea?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: It depends on the nature of the support.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Okay. You did give a comparison before in relation to the previous tranche of money, which was close to half. So can I put to you again that you would need something in the vicinity of at least 50 per cent, or around that ballpark figure, for the project to be completed?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: It really depends on the nature of the support.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I'm asking you that, though, Mr Barnes.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: The nature of the support determines the credit rating outcome.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Yes. So I'm asking you: in order to maintain your credit rating, is it the case that you would need roughly the same proportion as you just explained in relation to the previous tranche of funding, which was an additional contribution of around 50 per cent, or approximately $5 billion, from government?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Again, the work is underway with the departments on the nature of that support.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: But we are talking around that figure. We are not talking $100 million; we are talking in that ballpark?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: We are talking a substantial proportion, but as I say, the work is underway to determine what that would be.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: So is a 'substantial proportion' more than 50 per cent?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I think it's best for the work to happen, and that's now underway.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: You have got a pretty good idea, because you have just given evidence that a substantial proportion of the $10 billion will be required as a government contribution. So can you please explain what you mean by 'substantial' contribution?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Chair, Senator Henderson has now asked, essentially, the same question in at least a dozen different ways. Mr Barnes has shared the information that he has on this. Senator Henderson can keep asking the same question for the rest of the night if she prefers, but I'd ask you to consider whether we're getting into repetitive questioning territory.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Thank you, Minister. I think senators are entitled to explore inquiries in different ways or from different angles. I can't say that I have precisely followed each of the last half a dozen questions, so I'm not in a position to rule this one out of order, but I think it is also an opportune time to say that that's about 17 minutes, Senator Henderson, on this block.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I will try and move through very quickly. So in terms of the advice that you've given government, Mr Barnes, was that written advice?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Yes.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Could we have a copy of that advice.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: The question would probably be best placed with the department.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: No. I'm seeking the copy of the advice from you, Mr Barnes.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: It is a confidential document which has an incredible amount of potentially damaging information for our relationship with our contractor if it were to be made public.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: That's not a reason in itself. The fact that it's confidential is not a reason not to provide that document.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I think, to help Mr Barnes out, the appropriate thing for Mr Barnes to do would be to take that on notice.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I was about to say that, Minister. If you wish, take that on notice, but this is a very important document for our scrutiny of this massive project, including the cost blowout. So, if you could, take it on notice. I also want to say that Minister Bowen said that he would make this public. We're talking about potentially billions of additional dollars that taxpayers are being asked to stump up as a result of what, I would put to you, is gross mismanagement. And I would say, Mr Barnes, that, despite what Minister Ayres said before, the renegotiation of the contract in 2023 shifted a lot of the liability from the contractor to Snowy in a way that has exposed taxpayers to potentially billions of dollars more money. So these are critical questions in terms of the job that we are doing in Senate estimates. Can I ask, in relation to this additional support, when this is required by—because time, I imagine, is of the essence.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: We've obviously got to go through a process with departments. Snowy Hydro is, as we attest in our annual report, solvent and liquid and can accommodate the costs for the next year.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: What contingencies have you made in terms of this additional funding? Have you got any backup plan?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: We will need support by the middle of next year.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: By the middle of next year?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Yes.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: And why that timing, Mr Barnes?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: It's a combination of the spend on the project, how much we earn and what private debt we can access.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: And have you had any indications that you are going to be able to access private debt? I would have thought that a lot of potential lenders would be running a mile from this project.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: We find that the debt capital markets actually provide a degree of liquidity to Snowy Hydro, so we don't see people running away. But the objective of the support is to maintain our credit rating to continue our incredibly important role in the electricity market.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Can you guarantee—I did address this with you before—that no more than $25 billion will be required to complete this project?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: As I said before, I believe the $2.8 billion of risk and contingency will allow us to complete the project. However, there are no guarantees when we're dealing with something so complex.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Minister, in relation to this additional ask, which could be $5 billion, could be more, is this a consideration for MYEFO or for the next budget—for the May budget?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I think Mr Barnes has indicated that Snowy Hydro would be seeking a decision on that by the middle of next year, so I'm not going to commit the government to a particular timeframe without having taken advice on that. But I think what this all shows is that, to use Barnaby Joyce's words, it would have been best if this wasn't all worked out on the back of a beer coaster all those years ago when Mr Taylor was the energy minister.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I appreciate that you're so desperate, Minister, that that's all you can say.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Well, that's where this all started.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: But the fact of the matter is that, when this project left the coalition's hands in 2022, the ANAO gave this a tick of approval. The project cost of—

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: What report did you read?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Excuse me, Minister, I'm speaking.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: That's no ANAO report I've read! Do you want me to tell you what the ANAO report actually said?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: The 2022 report. You don't even know the difference between the 2026 report and the 2022 report. In the 2022 report, at $5.9 billion, the ANAO said the project was on budget, on time and it raised no concerns, in stark contrast to 2026.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Have you read the—

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: So this project has gone—

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: more recent ANAO report—

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Excuse me, I'm—

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: which completely contradicts that?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Minister, I'm speaking. Minister, I would say to you, very clearly, this project has gone off the rails in the most dramatic fashion under your government.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I think you could question whether it was ever on the rails in the first place.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Well, the ANAO, an independent agency, gave this project the tick of approval under the coalition government in 2022.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Have you read the more recent report from ANAO, which found that, as early as January 2020, when Mr Taylor was the energy minister, the project was facing significant cost warnings. They also found that the 2023 reset was worth doing, saying that the negotiation of the project reset in 2023 was informed by a largely sound approach to planning and advice et cetera. I know you're not a fan of Malcolm Turnbull, but this goes back to his announcement—

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Please don't reflect on me in that way.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: of $2 billion—

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: That's just inappropriate.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: which, in Barnaby Joyce's words, was dreamed up on the back of a beer coaster. That's where these issues began, and that's what you should be also taking into account.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Minister, your own energy minister, Chris Bowen, who should resign because of this horrendous cost blowout, said in February of this year that the project was on track. He even made a social media video about it. So your own government is lying to the Australian people about this project.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: That should be withdrawn, Chair.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Your own government.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Senator Henderson—

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I'm saying 'your government'.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Senator Henderson, I think we're getting close to the line of what we usually accept as parliamentary, but also—

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Your own—

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I'm conscious that we are running incredibly—

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I appreciate that. Let me move on. Mr Barnes, in 2022, what was the average annual wage of an FTE worker?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: On Snowy 2.0 or in—

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: On Snowy 2.0.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I'd have to take that on notice.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: The reason I ask this is I'm looking for the acceleration of the wage, because, according to the GHD project benefits analysis, on page 22, the annual wage of a worker in 2024 was $120,000. So I'm seeking the figure for 2022. You can take that on notice. Do you know what is the current average annual wage of a worker now?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Again, I would have to take that on notice.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: My concern is, Mr Barnes, that the EBA which governs this project has completely blown out. Eighty per cent of the costs relate to labour costs. That's correct, isn't it?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: That's correct.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: The blowout is extraordinary, and you don't know the average annual wage of workers on your own project?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I was expecting to be asked the question of what the EBA had contributed to the cost differential between 2012 and 2022.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Okay, but this is Senate estimates. Eighty per cent of the costs of this project are attributed to labour. So can you give me a breakdown? You can't give me any sort of breakdown on the average annual wage per worker now?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: No, I don't have that data with me.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: So it's the case that, of the, say, additional $10 billion in blowout, 80 per cent is attributable to wages?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: There are obviously two things in the cost. One is the rate you pay someone, and the number of people and for how long. Of the $10 billion, a little over $5 billion is associated with more people for longer. So it's not necessarily a rate question.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: But isn't it the case also that the average annual rate has increased?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Yes. In 2025 the EBA was renegotiated, and that was renegotiated to a market rate which was independently verified at that time.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text:
Can I just take you to the ANAO's latest report, at page 73. It says:

In the corporate planning process, Snowy Hydro included the impact of the renewed EBA as one of the pressures on the project achieving the target cost.

Can you confirm that is the case?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Yes.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Can you expand on that pressure, please?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: As I described earlier, the escalations that have contributed to the $10 billion—of $2.5 billion, we obviously have a range on this because we don't know how many people for how long precisely, and we have not yet agreed a variation with our contractor. But the impact of the EBA renegotiation was a little under a billion dollars.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: So you're saying that, as a result of the EBA renegotiation, just under a billion dollars was added to the total cost of the project?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Yes.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Can you give me the precise figure?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: We haven't got a precise figure because we haven't agreed the variation with the contractor yet. I wouldn't want to prejudice that discussion. And the precise figure obviously relies on the number of people for how long, but the figure within the $22.2 billion is just under $1 billion.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: And can you break that down? What are the cost drivers in the EBA that you've renegotiated?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: It's a combination of rates, allowances and various matters which are published on the Fair Work Commission website.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: And, as Mr Barnes has said, the EBA rates were found to be in line with market rates.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: So that's still under negotiation, is it, or hasn't yet been agreed?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: The EBA is finalised with the workers, and that's on the Fair Work Commission website. Obviously, with our contractor, we don't just say, 'Yes, here's just under a billion dollars.' We make sure that there is very robust documentation to support a variation in the target cost. Now, it's an allowable cost, so we will be paying those costs. It's whether those costs contribute to the contractor's performance or penalty regime, and that's the bit that's still under negotiation.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: So, given it's not agreed, could it go beyond $1 billion—the impact of the EBA?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: No, the costs will be just under a billion dollars. The negotiation is about whether the contractor has it included in its target cost or whether it is part of a penalty that the contractor will face. And the precise detail of that—we don't disagree with the contractor on the need for a variation; we're just making sure that the detail is correct.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: So what are the barriers to finalising the EBA?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: The EBA is finalised.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: To finalising the cost.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: It's the standard of documentation we require from the contractor to confirm that.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Are you concerned that this process could slow the work down?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: No.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: You've talked about almost a billion dollars in additional costs. What's driving that? You've talked about rates of pay and allowances. Where are the big pressures on the additional costs?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Perhaps it's worth also just explaining that the EBA covers the workers of SC Hydro, who are the employing entity for our contractor. When you work on a site like Snowy Hydro, you then contract many more subcontractors over time, and the subcontractors obviously look to enjoy the same rates as the head contractor. So it comes from many different subcontractors. That's the first point. I think the majority of the costs—and, again, this is in the Fair Work Commission ruling—would be in the rates of pay.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: It's the rates of pay, is it? That's the big driver?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: That would be the majority of it.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: And how much have wages gone up under this new arrangement?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Again, I'd have to take that on notice because it's a very complex set of arrangements.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: On average, though? You must know. You must know the average increase in wages.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I think the headline rate is in the order of five per cent a year.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Five per cent. Okay. In the GHD document it stated that jobs are expected to peak in 2027. With the equivalent of almost 6,600 full-time jobs supported directly by construction—in 2027, the total number of FTE jobs supported in any year of the project is expected to peak at approximately 18,700. That's the GHD document. Can you tell me what the cost forecast will be for supporting this 18,700-strong workforce?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: The workforce employed by Future Generation Joint Venture is in the order of 5½ thousand. GHD have done pretty typical input/output modelling to go, 'What effect does that have on the economy'—all of the various support services and supplies that come from all over Australia. We don't pay for those. We pay for the people. And the people on the job, as a result of the EBA, will have an impact, accounted for in the $10 billion of just under a billion dollars.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Is the CFMEU driving this EBA? Is that the principal union?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: We have a wide range of union representation on the site: AWU, AMWU, CFMEU.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Do you know what the breakdown is?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I don't think you're allowed to know what the breakdown is, but the majority at the moment would be AWU.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Okay. Did the EBA do anything in relation to productivity? Are you seeing productivity gains as a result of this huge uplift in costs?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: The project was stalled in 2023, so we have seen productivity improve progressively over the last three to four years.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: No, I'm talking about the EBA. Does the EBA contain any productivity conditions or—

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Making sure a project is no longer stalled would represent a productivity gain.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: No, Minister, I don't need smart cracks from you. I'm asking Mr Barnes—

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I'm just reflecting on where the project was at when you left office.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: whether there were particular productivity KPIs in the EBA.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I think the workers who work remotely from home, two weeks on, one week off, often doing 12-hour shifts underground, have enough productivity drive that the EBA didn't require productivity measures of that nature. I don't know what they would look like.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: We're obviously very concerned about the cost reassessment. Senator Smith has asked about the OPD. Do you have a copy of the cost reassessment with you?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: No.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Are you able to provide us a copy today?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I think I answered earlier that I would take that on notice.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: What's the barrier, in not providing that document?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: There's no single document. There's a raft of supporting information. We have a single prime contractor on this job, we have to ensure that value for money is achieved through that relationship, and there's a lot of commercially confidential information in that documentation.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Okay. Can we get a copy of the EBA, please?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: It's on the Fair Work Commission website.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Well, I'm asking for a copy.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: We'll happily provide that on notice.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Mr Barnes, for nearly a billion dollars in additional costs, I am concerned that there are no specific productivity gains as part of that uplift in wages and other allowances. Is there anything that you can point to in that document in relation to productivity gains?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I'd have to take it on notice, but, like I said, the majority of the workers travel two weeks on, one week off, to an extreme environment and work under harsh conditions underground. I think those workers being well served by good transport and good conditions on site contributes to the productivity. There aren't, from recollection, any specific productivity measures—that is, where you get paid more or less. I think they're often counterproductive, particularly when we're working in a high-hazard environment and we want people to take safety first.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: What is the current net present value of the project?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: As I referred to earlier, we've provided a range of economic modelling. The net present value relies on an assumption of a cost of capital. Snowy 2.0 reduces the cost of capital of Snowy overall because it provides resilient earnings. As we go through the discussions with the departments on the support required to complete the project, we'll take on notice the question of a business case or an NPV licence.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Okay. The project benefit analysis released last week did not include an updated net present value. That is a pretty critical figure.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: The GHD report I think you're referring to showed the benefits that accrued to the broader economy during construction and as a result of lower electricity prices rather than the earnings that accrued to Snowy Hydro.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I'm going to press you on this because you would know this figure, Mr Barnes. Do you know the current net present value? I should perhaps—

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Net present value relies on an analysis of the cost of capital—

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Yes.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: and it relies on an analysis of an electricity market that does not yet exist and an asset that is 150 years. So there's quite—

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: So has it increased or decreased from 2024?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: The electricity market modelling we've done suggests that Snowy 2.0 is more required than it was in 2024. So the revenue accruing to Snowy 2.0 has increased.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: In terms of the modelling, could we please get a copy of that modelling?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Chair, can I just say, at that point—I'll leave it for Mr Barnes to answer the question—there are a number of figures and documents that Senator Henderson has requested, and, as Mr Barnes has said, some of that information is commercial-in-confidence. We need to remember that Snowy Hydro competes in the energy market with a number of other entities, and I'm sure Snowy Hydro's board will take into account what they can and can't release publicly. If Senator Henderson has any quibble with that, that's exactly the point Mr Taylor made back in 2019 in refusing to release Snowy Hydro's business case at that point in time.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I think the appropriate way to manage this is for those questions to be taken on notice. If it is not in the public interest for those documents to be released under a request through Senate estimates, then that case can be made or those reasons can be set out and then dealt with in a similar way.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I'm going to try and be very quick.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Senator Henderson, I'd just point out that you've been going now for about 40 minutes—

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I appreciate that.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: so we're now running significantly further behind than we were.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Mr Barnes, the net present value figure was disclosed in 2024, when the business case was done then. Has that figure increased or decreased since 2024?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: The 2024 analysis was on a very specific market scenario and a very specific cost scenario. We have now considered the range of costs between 2022 and 2025, and we've considered a more fulsome range of revenue scenarios, as well as the understanding of how Snowy 2.0 will work in the Snowy Hydro portfolio as a reduced cost of capital. So it would be misleading to give a single figure. There are a range of economic outcomes for Snowy 2.0. In our annual report on Friday, they were considered as part of our impairment modelling. No write-down or impairment is predicted.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: So can you give me a range?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I can give you a range of the return on asset, which is different to an NPV. And we believe, under a very broad range of scenarios, recognising the unique nature of the asset over 150 years, the range is—

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Sorry, Mr Barnes. What I'm confused about is that, when you did the business case back in 2024, you were able to give that particular figure. And so, given the cost blowout now to $25 billion, I would have thought that you would have done the work to establish a new NPV.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Well, we've done a range of economic modelling. Recognising that Snowy 2.0 is within a portfolio of other assets—it will be about 20 per cent of our capacity—we have a return range of between five per cent and six per cent modelled, recognising the limitations of the modelling.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Yes. Senator Canavan—

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: So your rate of return is five per cent or six per cent?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: The asset rate of return specifically for Snowy 2.0, as modelled, we believe to be in the range of five per cent to six per cent.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: You've modelled that over 150 years?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: It becomes academic after about 50 years.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Of course. It seems a very—

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: So the model cuts off in—

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: [Inaudible] not about that age, so it seems strange. So 150 years you're modelling—

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: The asset life is 150 years. The modelling, I think, we do over 50 years to recognise that it's somewhat academic.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: So, in your NPV, do you use a weighted average cost of capital?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I've given you the asset return rather than the weighted average cost of capital.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Is that asset return a return on equity or a return on assets?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: A return on assets.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: What was the WACC you used for the NPV calculation?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: We haven't done that analysis or published that analysis.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: So you haven't used a WACC?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Asset rate of return doesn't require a—

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I know that. But you've done a net present value calculation of some range; is that correct?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Our WACC, as published in 2024, we would have published at 6.1 per cent. But, given the nature of the Snowy 2.0 asset within Snowy Hydro, we believe it will reduce our weighted average cost of capital over time. We haven't brought that together into a single analysis.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: So your WACC is between five per cent and six per cent now?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: The integrated system plan that AEMO use uses a range of three per cent for regulated assets and seven per cent to 12 per cent for unregulated assets. Snowy 2.0 is unregulated, in that sense, but it does have a very unique role in this future energy market.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: It's a little perplexing to me that the WACC has reduced over the past two years, given that the cost of capital, and capital markets have seen interest rates increase considerably. So can you explain to me how—

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I didn't say the WACC had reduced.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I think you did. I thought I did hear—

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I said the WACC—

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: You said the structure of capital has changed such that you've been able to reduce the WACC.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: No; we believe that over time the role of Snowy 2.0 and Snowy Hydro will reduce our cost of capital. We haven't—

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Okay. Does that mean it will reduce the WACC? Between the cost of capital and the WACC, it's—

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: We haven't done a business case or an analysis for publication which brings all of that together. In 2024, we did that. We've now considered that to be quite a limited view of the role of Snowy 2.0.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Can you explain to me how the cost of capital for any type of analysis of this has reduced in the context of significantly higher interest rates, including for the Australian government, in the past two years?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: This is an area not of my expertise. We'd be happy to provide more detail on notice. But the risk to our earnings within Snowy Hydro, given the unique nature of the asset, given it's not reliant on water inflows, reduces the risk in the business, which would reduce the effect of the cost of capital for Snowy Hydro.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: You haven't really been able to explain this issue. Excuse my cynicism, but this is a project that's now one of the biggest blowouts in Australian history, and it would appear that you're goal seeking or seeking to generate a particular WACC to avoid a write-down, to me. That's the clear conclusion from the evidence you've given because it's very opaque. You're not really giving us transparency here to the public about how you could have a declining cost of capital in a market where Australian government bond rates in the past couple of years have gone up something like 140 basis points. An input in your WACC is some kind of Australian government bond rate, I presume? That would be one of the inputs?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: That would be one of our inputs.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Right. And that has increased considerably. The only other way you would probably get a significant reduction is if you were mucking around with debt and equity ratios. Have you changed your leverage ratio for your WACC considerably?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: In our annual report, in the impairment section, which is audited by our external auditor, who had full information on the range of market scenarios and capital costs—they affirmed that there is no impairment or write-down as a result of that analysis.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: And they get it wrong time and time again. We've also got an audit process here. I'm just not quite sure why you can't disclose to this committee the inputs to your WACC. So what government bond rate did you use this time, relative to 2024?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: I'd have to take the detail of this on notice.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Okay. If you take that one on notice, can you also take on notice the leverage ratio you've used, the alpha that you've calculated or used in 2024 compared to 2026 and what that weighted average cost of capital was in 2024 relatively to 2026.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: We'll take it on notice.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Have you benchmarked your returns relative to companies in the utilities sector to calculate your WACC?

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: We don't do that, but I think I would bring attention to the unique nature of Snowy 2.0. We identified earlier this year that there is no asset that will do what Snowy 2.0 does. The integrated system plan produced by AEMO uses a wide range of costs of capital.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: The reason this is so important, Mr Barnes, is that Australians deserve to know that this project is still going to deliver economic benefits to the nation. In 2024, there was a positive NPV of $3 billion based on a $12 billion construction cost and completion by December 2028. It's just very concerning that that reassessment either has not been completed or is not available, given how important it is for Australians to know that this is going to deliver economic benefits to the country.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Well, I think Mr Barnes has previously outlined some of the economic benefits that the project would provide to the country.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
text: Well, that's why I'm seeking the update. I'm seeking the update of net present value for that very reason.

agency: Snowy Hydro Ltd
portfolio: CLIMATE CHANGE, ENERGY, THE ENVIRONMENT AND WATER PORTFOLIO
